shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; echo ---; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ---; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | grep -iE 'dialog|modal|button'

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1 | head -1; npm ls -g playwright 2>/dev/null | grep playwright) ; echo "exit"
ls node_modules | grep -iE '^(jsdom|happy-dom|@testing-library)$'; echo "---"; git status --short
